{{- /*
  Overrides the theme's llms.txt template.

  The theme's version lists sections and their pages, which on this site produces little
  more than a single link to one post -- it skips the home page, because Hugo treats it as
  the list page rather than content. On this site the home page IS the content: the bio,
  the writing on prompt pipelines and backcasting, and the project table all live there.
  An index that omits it describes the wrong site.

  So this adds to the theme's structure: the site description as the summary line the
  llms.txt format expects after the title (https://llmstxt.org/), a line saying whose site
  this is, the author's profiles (params.schema.sameAs, the same list as the structured
  data) and an explicit link to the home page. The recursive section printer below is the
  theme's, unchanged.
*/ -}}

{{- define "llms_print_section" -}}
{{- $section := .section -}}
{{- $depth := .depth -}}
{{- if or (gt (len $section.RegularPages) 0) (gt (len $section.Sections) 0) -}}
{{- $hashes := strings.Repeat (add $depth 1) "#" }}

{{ printf "%s %s" $hashes $section.Title }}
{{- range $p := $section.RegularPages }}
  {{- if and (not $p.Params.searchHidden) (ne $p.Layout `archives`) (ne $p.Layout `search`) }}
- [{{ $p.Title }}]({{ $p.Permalink }}){{ with $p.Description }}: {{ . }}{{ end }}
  {{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- range $s := $section.Sections -}}
{{- template "llms_print_section" (dict "section" $s "depth" (add $depth 1)) -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}

{{- /* Main template */ -}}
{{- $profileNames := dict "github.com" "GitHub" "www.linkedin.com" "LinkedIn" "stackoverflow.com" "Stack Overflow" "x.com" "X" -}}
# {{ site.Title }}
{{ with site.Params.description }}
> {{ . }}
{{ end }}
This is the personal site of {{ site.Params.author }}{{ with site.Params.schema.alternateName }}, also known as {{ . }}{{ end }}. The home page is his background and what he has been learning and building: {{ site.Home.Permalink }}

## Profiles
{{ range site.Params.schema.sameAs }}
- [{{ index $profileNames (urls.Parse .).Host | default (urls.Parse .).Host }}]({{ . }})
{{- end }}

## Explorables

- [Explorables](https://explorables.kphutt.com/): interactive explainers you can play with, starting with a backup-power storm test

## Home

- [{{ site.Title }}]({{ site.Home.Permalink }}): background, and notes on prompt pipelines and backcasting.

{{- $orphans := where site.RegularPages "Section" "" -}}
{{ if gt (len $orphans) 0 }}
{{- range $p := $orphans -}}
  {{ if and (not $p.Params.searchHidden) (ne $p.Layout `archives`) (ne $p.Layout `search`) (not $p.IsHome) }}
- [{{ $p.Title }}]({{ $p.Permalink }}){{ with $p.Description }}: {{ . }}{{ end }}
  {{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}

{{- range site.Sections -}}
{{- template "llms_print_section" (dict "section" . "depth" 1) -}}
{{- end }}
